title: The Diametral Metric Dimension of Generalized Corona Graph
summary: This study investigates the diametral metric dimension of generalized corona graphs, where the main graph is connected graph and the branch graphs form a sequence of connected graphs. The concept of diametral metric dimension is an extension of the metric dimension concept, requiring the resolving set to contain all diametral vertices. To determine the diametral metric dimension of a generalized corona graph, one must first identify the distance of each vertex in the graph and the graph's diametral set.
